column1: # OWASP ZAP Scan Rules for Clickra
# Rules IGNORED — False positives for desktop app context
# Clickra is a Windows desktop app, not a web application.
# These rules produce false positives when scanning external API
# These rules are NOT ignored and will be reported as WARN:
# 10015 - Incomplete or No Cache-control and Pragma HTTP Header Set
# 10036 - Server Leaks version info via "Server" HTTP response header
# 10053 - Information disclosure - sensitive data in URL
